II research case study, aggregate summaries

Author and copyright holder: Keith A. Preble
APSA Preprints paper: Commercial Embeddedness and Sanctions Busting: Intra-Industry
Trade, Dependence, and Economic Asymmetry.
Posted November 16, 2026. DOI: 10.33774/apsa-2026-7wxvk
https://doi.org/10.33774/apsa-2026-7wxvk

The bundle ii-case-study.rds contains aggregate summaries of the saved research
replication and additional internal prediction validation completed on
13 November 2026. It contains no individual country-pair-year records, fitted
models, row-level predictions, or country identifiers.

Use readRDS() to inspect it. The named list includes metadata and a provenance
table of original relative file paths and MD5 hashes, followed by aggregate
tables, including the observed, representative-prediction, and difference
heatmaps across the three paper GDP grouping rules. No external file needs to be downloaded to read the vignette.
The development project's data-raw/build_ii_case_study.R records the extraction.

The original category integration check used binwise 0.0.9. The saved validation
used binwise 0.0.10. The current build rechecks all category assignments using
the full local replication sample; it does not refit any research model.
Scores and intervals cannot be reconstructed by fitting models to these cell
summaries. Full replication requires the research data and recorded environment.

All original estimates, manuscript files, and source datasets are preserved.
The vignette distinguishes original paper specifications from the subsequent
continuous comparisons, confidence diagnostics, and internal held-out checks.
The statistical scope and limitations are documented in the vignette and help.
